about_the_game:
Ammo Bounce is a high-adrenaline, neon-drenched reinvention of the classic brick breaker — but this time, forget the ball. You’re unleashing a spinning buzzsaw of destruction that carves through anything standing in its way!

Your mission: take command of the deflector platform and turn every bounce into a burst of chaos. Hurl your deadly saw against relentless waves of enemies and destructible obstacles. But beware — not all foes are easy targets. Some dodge unpredictably, others are shielded on multiple sides, and a few cunning ones even build barriers in real time to block your attacks.

Perfect your timing, master ricochets, and embrace controlled mayhem as you collect powerful upgrades mid-battle. Add extra saws, widen your platform, or trigger temporary boosts to dominate the arena — but choose wisely. Certain items can shrink your paddle, steal your weapon, or even cost you a precious life.

Explosive, fast, and intensely satisfying, every stage of Ammo Bounce transforms into a glowing arena of metal, reflexes, and chaos.

⚙️ Key Features

  • 🌀 A brutal evolution of the brick breaker genre

  • ⚔️ Wield a lethal buzzsaw instead of a ball — slice, ricochet, and destroy

  • 🔧 Power-ups and traps that reshape each match in seconds

  • 🧠 Enemies with unique tactics: unpredictable movement, heavy armor, or instant barriers

  • 🎶 Electric soundtrack and vivid cyber-neon visuals
